review_description: Redearth provided very clear explanations and even offered a virtual tour of their Australian factory. Their system is scalable meaning that you can upgrade the battery over time, and thus start more economically.

A very good experience with Red Earth / New Eden Energy. (Almost trouble free - unfortunately Origin dropped the ball!) Excellent customer service all the way through. Very professional team of installers.

I thought I did get the Red Earth quote from you people. But its not in the list above.I did have to chase up some things myself but that was not a big problem at all. Very happy with the service and they didn't take too long from order to installation.
